notes: Reset panel to defaults no longer blows the OG Widget up to full width. It was coming back at 1280 pixels wide instead of 215.

This was a different fault from the sizing bugs fixed in 1.1.242 and 1.1.244, which is why those did not catch it. Reset does not adjust the current size — it substitutes a whole different one, the 1024x768 baseline every full-size panel…
A widget now resets to the size its own design declares, converted for whichever display it is on, keeping its position and letting its height follow its content as usual.
